name: template-media
body: Project media: fonts, logos, images, video and any other file type under `templates/themes/<name>/` or `templates/media/` are served by `kalide start` from the project directory (offline, 127.0.0.1 only) with a content type derived from the file extension; there is no allow-list of media types. Reference rules: layouts reference shared media via `{{media "path"}}`, the path being relative to `templates/media/` only (no absolute paths, no `..`); theme-owned files (fonts, logos in `themes/<name>/`) are referenced only from that theme's `theme.css` via relative `url()` and are served from the theme directory — `media` never resolves into a theme. AC: a `.woff2`, an `.svg` and an `.mp4` placed under `templates/media/` and referenced from a layout via `media` are served and resolve in the rendered deck; a `.woff2` in `templates/themes/<name>/fonts/` referenced by relative `url()` from its `theme.css` is served and resolves.
